Dead flag elimination through nonfaulting register moves: three-run camera-pan median 36.67 FPS versus 36.8 baseline; p95 62.4 ms versus 61.8 ms. Removed; reproducible patch in experiments/dead-flags.patch.

compatibilityBoundaries: x87 still uses binary64 arithmetic. New executable tests document extended-format roundtrip and precision/exponent losses; no software extended-precision migration was attempted.
The small CP1252 table remains. A broad encoding library was a conditional candidate in the review, not an established improvement for this single-code-page runtime.
Browser Wasm adapters remain custom and covered by runtime tests. Library consolidation was applied to the Rust compiler; build-time conversion of all browser adapters remains unimplemented.

measurementLimits: Initial per-change series used a single controlled baseline. The dead-flags investigation used three runs per build. The retained classification comparison used three baseline controls bracketed by two batches of three optimized runs; all remain small single-machine samples.
Scene timing uses screenshots sampled every 250 ms plus screenshot overhead.
Native replay and raster microbenchmarks are not end-to-end browser speedups.
The initial optimization series showed no gameplay FPS gain. The subsequent compositor classification experiment measured about 4% in one community-pan scenario; p95 frame time did not improve.
